scope: Run the qualified held-file exact directory/name correspondence inside the existing owned Windows NTFS reader, and independently reconstruct all input/source/profile/prefix/domain/report relationships from retained bytes in the parent. No public membership dispatch, physical source, namespace/collation/lookup/content, writer or full original 0.1.0 qualification.
ownership: Extend existing NtfsSnapshotKind/Input, ntfs_snapshot.h/.cpp, NtfsWorker and its private probe. Keep one process role, inherited-handle host, payload mapping, parser family, opener and immutable snapshot lifetime. Add no second scheduler, duplicate parser, provider tree or speculative hierarchy. Parent verification invokes the pure supplied-reader observer and never the native opener.
input: Add Membership kind with default target_limit 64, valid 1..256, alongside the existing directory reference/limits. Membership request uses org.disked.ntfs-membership-source-request/1 and includes the decimal target_limit. Unknown kinds/fields reject. Bootstrap/Directory retain their exact existing wire shape/schema/defaults and reject nondefault membership controls instead of ignoring them. Seal exact capture epoch, expected ordinary-file metadata, path/window, profile, global quotas and all graph/target controls before process launch. NtfsSnapshotKind is currently owned by runtime/capture/ntfs_capture.h; append Membership while preserving old enum values. Existing public inspection validators continue to reject the new private kind until separate admission.
frame: Membership uses org.disked.ntfs-membership-region-frame/1 and org.disked.ntfs-membership-file-capture/1. Bind exact input/epoch, actual process identity and every ordered native response, including attempted seek/read, errors/refusals and bytes. Generic NTFS worker publication envelopes may stay v1 because the exact input/frame/request digest binds the kind. Context image_profile is ordinary-file-ntfs-membership. Preserve Bootstrap/Directory contexts, output schemas and bytes.
reconstruction: Run the same pure membership observer over retained responses after strict source metadata, provenance, trace and budget checks. Explicit/automatic 3.1 consume the whole frame. Automatic3.0 derives the natural 3.1 bootstrap prefix from pure observation, requires supported 3.0 with qualified bootstrap prerequisites, validates that exact prefix under 3.0 up to its first missing new read, compares normalized foundations including requested_target_limit and requested directory reference, then reconstructs the selected complete observation. Do not trust child prefix counts/hashes or silently repair claims.
receipts: Recompute probe hash/count, prefix validation report hash, both normalized foundation hashes, flags, selected profile/domain, total pure pass/replay/reuse counts and exact final report. Membership capture.domain provider is ntfs-membership-file-prototype and target_limit is included in its digest. Preserve structurally valid pre-target/prefix/error/budget partial observations, but reject any forged control, identity, hash, provenance, unknown field or mismatched reconstruction.
consistency: Keep complete collection, all-edge correspondence, source metadata/binding checks, replay equality and aggregate eligibility separate. A valid complete name mismatch may be retained as an immutable snapshot with applicable/observed_stable false; it is not a source-binding diagnostic. Invalid/stale/unsupported/changed/failed/quota evidence remains incomplete and nonapplicable. Source-free reconstruction proves retained relationships, not child authenticity, current live bytes, renewed opening authority, an atomic snapshot or effects.
lifecycle: Reuse ObservationWorker session/code/request/attempt/observer/worker/capture identities, inherited handles, job/process budgets, finite waits/cancellation/retirement and actual PID/creation checks. Prepare opens no source; capture begins after release. Publish a snapshot only after validated completion and real owned child exit. Live/uncertain/stalled child has no admitted result. Preserve immutable result/context/optional frame after teardown. No writer quiescence or public admission claim.
bounds: Keep input 128KiB, payload 8MiB, observation 2MiB (including post-binding diagnostics), receipt 64KiB, native read/retention/output quotas and job 128MiB. At most 512 responses/2MiB requested raw bytes produce at most 4MiB hex. Existing conservative frame bound7020544 bytes remains below 8MiB; bound metadata scalars and JSON depth/values/strings separately. Membership target caps do not enlarge another budget. Refuse overflow before publication; do not enlarge timeouts/quotas for fixtures.
testing: Define independent generated MembershipVolume tuple/read/hash expectations before native evaluation. Cover both versions/profiles, automatic-prefix reuse, deep/fragmented/list/bitmap/target-extension graphs, raw names/identical instances/aliases, complete mismatch and partial read/stale/quota/changed cases. Verify source-free replay after removing the generated source, actual exited child/process/code/capture identities, inert preparation, copied controls and retained immutable snapshots. Corrupt each new input/schema/target/domain/foundation/report/name/count/receipt/provenance/claim relationship, including coherent child report changes that parent replay must reject. Separate normal/fault compositions; normal rejects all test controls. Exercise real launch/release/cancel/hang/late/exit/startup/retirement and zero-wait outcomes, retaining dependencies for uncertainty. Preserve old NTFS bootstrap/directory/public/common-worker behavior. Predefine exact affected current-group qualification closure, full tooling/import/header/C90/source-bound context, and selected Win32 supplement before implementation. Broaden for common-host changes.
acceptance: Actual owned membership workers retain independently expected source-bound raw-name correspondence and exact native/profile/prefix/domain/replay facts for both profiles, with unchanged source hashes and actual exited child/code identities. Parent source-free verification never reopens the source.

Malformed/forged input/frame/publication cannot yield a usable snapshot; valid complete mismatch and incomplete observations stay distinguishable and nonapplicable. Bootstrap/Directory exact old wires/outputs and normal/fault isolation remain compatible.

Finite frame/encoding/process/wait/cancel/retirement evidence, compiler/import/header checks, predefined affected regressions, tooling/context/manifest and agent review are retained before source integration. No public/owner/full-platform/storage/release acceptance is manufactured.

qualification.scope: All-target fresh pinned x64 build and the predefined 34 affected native groups out of 167 expected registered;67 standalone headers,13 executable PE/import observations, strict C90, full tooling/context/manifest and a private 12-group Win32 supplement. Not full current167-group or full Win32/legacy qualification.
qualification.expansion: If common worker/reader/JSON/presentation algorithms or public admission change, resolve impact and broaden the exact regression closure before relying on results.
qualification.failure_policy: Retain any failure verbatim. Raw worker state/elapsed must be recorded before helper assertions. Another unexplained availability failure requires measurements of its retained state before a further fresh campaign; no deadline/assertion growth or unlimited green chasing.

test_seam: Fault-only worker modes membership_changed and target_changed alter the new observation/control relationships before a correctly hashed publication. They are rejected for Bootstrap/Directory and in normal compositions. No new runtime environment switch or public dispatch is admitted.
